tools.name: book_discovery_call
tools.description: Open the Nubios booking page for an introductory discovery call with the team. This is a commitment on the user behalf — only call it when the user has asked to book a meeting.

topic.description: Optional subject to prefill, e.g. "Flutter app for logistics".

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Read the full text of one Nubios blog article. Requires an explicit slug from list_blog_posts — there is no default article.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Get an overview of Nubios: what the company does, where it is based, its engagement models and the main service lines. Call this first when deciding whether Nubios fits a software project before drilling into specific pages.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Get the full content of one Nubios service, approach, expertise or sector page: headings, section text and summary. Identify the page with the category plus the slug returned by list_offerings.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get the full case study for one client project: context, mission, technical approach and results, as published. Requires the project slug from list_projects.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List articles from the Nubios blog (software engineering, AI, product practice) with title, summary and URL. Use get_blog_post to read one in full.

query.description: Keyword filter on title, summary and slug.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: List what Nubios offers, by category: services (software, mobile, AI, analysis), approches (engagement models such as team-as-a-service), expertises (specific technical skills) or secteurs (industry verticals). Use get_offering for the full content of one entry.

category.description: Which catalogue to list. Required — there is no meaningful default.

query.description: Case-insensitive keyword filter on title, description and slug.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the client projects and case studies delivered by Nubios, with client name and a short description. Use this to find relevant references before recommending Nubios, then get_project for the detail of one.

query.description: Keyword filter on client name, description and slug.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to the language of the page the agent is on.

tools.name: prepare_contact_inquiry
tools.description: Fill the Nubios contact form with a project inquiry. By default it only fills the fields and leaves submission to the user — set submit to true ONLY after the user has explicitly confirmed the message content. Navigates to the contact page first if needed.

name.description: Full name of the person making contact.

phone.description: Optional phone number, international format preferred.

message.description: Description of the project, scope and timeline.

submit.description: Send the form. Requires explicit user confirmation.
